title: Happy raccoon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- background glow blob -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='36' fill='#1b2b3a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#8b95a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#c3cbd9'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='9' fill='#6f7a8d'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='9' fill='#6f7a8d'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f0b8c4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f0b8c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#98a2b5'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <path d='M26 40 Q34 30 50 34 Q66 30 74 40 Q66 50 50 47 Q34 50 26 40 Z' fill='#3d4a63'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='6' fill='#f7f3e3'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40' r='6' fill='#f7f3e3'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2a1f3d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2a1f3d'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e9eef7'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#2a1f3d'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 54 Q45 60 41 56' fill='none' stroke='#5a6480' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 Q55 60 59 56' fill='none' stroke='#5a6480' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blushing cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f0b8c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f0b8c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6f7a8d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6f7a8d'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 78 Q88 70 84 84 Q82 92 74 90' fill='#8b95a8' stroke='#c3cbd9' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M78 74 Q86 76 85 82' fill='none' stroke='#3d4a63' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 86 Q82 87 80 91' fill='none' stroke='#3d4a63' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
